hero_body: Three areas of focus, one way of working — close enough to your business to give advice you can actually use.

service_cards.title: Strategy & Systems Mentorship
service_cards.body: For founders and leaders untangling how the business actually runs — organizational structure, decision rights, and the operating systems that hold everything together as headcount and complexity grow.

service_cards.title: Automation & Digital Transformation Mentorship
service_cards.body: Hands-on guidance on where AI, automation, and low-code tools genuinely reduce manual work and cost — and just as importantly, where they'd be a waste of budget right now.

service_cards.title: Founder Sounding Board
service_cards.body: Regular 1:1 conversations for the decisions that are hard to make alone — vendor calls, hiring calls, priority calls — pressure-tested by someone who has made similar ones.

journey_heading: Every mentorship relationship follows the same path

journey_steps.title: A real look at where you're stuck
journey_steps.body: Before any advice, an honest conversation about what's actually happening in your business — not the pitch-deck version.

journey_steps.title: Working sessions, not workshops
journey_steps.body: Regular, focused sessions on the specific decisions and systems in front of you — reviewed and refined as your situation changes.

journey_steps.title: Systems you can run without us
journey_steps.body: The goal of every engagement is a business that runs on judgment your team has built, not dependence on ongoing mentorship.

practice_heading: What this looks like at Nikitha Build-Tech
practice_body: The Nikitha Build-Tech engagement runs on Strategy & Systems and Automation & Digital Transformation mentorship together — working through ERP rollout decisions, budget and reporting workflows, and where automation genuinely removes manual work across their Tumkur, Davangere, and Mudhol operations.
cta_heading: Which of these fits where you are right now?
cta_body: Tell us and we'll shape the first conversation around it.
